_purpose: Target security headers for richenquest.com (File 09 §7). Applied at the Catalyst hosting layer during the M4 spike — mechanism (console config, catalyst.json, or edge function) confirmed against a real project. If Catalyst cannot set a header, the documented fallback applies.

headers.Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; frame-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self' https://crm.zoho.in https://crm.zoho.com; frame-ancestors 'none'; upgrade-insecure-requests

_csp_when_embeds_land._when: Apply ONLY at the M4 embed spike, and only the directives the confirmed hosts actually need. Do not ship this at launch — the v1 site loads zero third-party resources, so the strict policy above costs nothing and is the strongest posture this site will ever be able to hold.
_csp_when_embeds_land.Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' *.zoho.com *.zoho.in *.zohopublic.com *.zohostatic.com *.zohocdn.com https://www.clarity.ms; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' *.zohostatic.com; img-src 'self' data: *.zoho.com *.zoho.in *.zohocdn.com https://*.clarity.ms; frame-src *.zoho.com *.zoho.in *.zohopublic.com; connect-src 'self' *.zoho.com *.zoho.in https://*.clarity.ms; font-src 'self'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self' *.zoho.com *.zoho.in; frame-ancestors 'none'

_notes: LAUNCH CSP IS STRICT BY DESIGN. Verified 2026-08-12: the built site loads no third-party resources, makes no fetch/XHR calls, and contains zero executable inline scripts and zero inline style attributes or <style> elements. Nothing in v1 needs a relaxation.

form-action allows crm.zoho.in / crm.zoho.com because the Web-to-Lead form POSTs DIRECTLY to Zoho (ADR-003 — no backend). Without this the browser silently blocks every submission. Both DCs listed: the org is India DC (.in), .com retained for the account-level fallback Zoho uses on some webform endpoints. No other directive is relaxed.

CORRECTION to the previous note: 'unsafe-inline' is NOT required for the JSON-LD blocks. A <script type="application/ld+json"> is an HTML data block — never executed, and not subject to script-src. All 28 inline scripts on the site are ld+json. Relaxing script-src for them would have weakened the policy for no reason.
frame-ancestors 'none' added — it is the directive modern browsers honour for clickjacking; X-Frame-Options is retained for older clients only.

GA4/Meta Pixel hosts intentionally ABSENT — add only after founder approval (File 13, Analytics). Microsoft Clarity likewise: it sets cookies, so it also requires the consent gate and a privacy-policy update FIRST (the policy commits to this in writing).
Fallback if headers are unsupported at the host: meta-tag CSP (reduced coverage; no HSTS/frame-ancestors) + Cloudflare-proxied DNS as a last resort — founder decision required for the latter.
